manifest.name: @lczment/dsh-window
manifest.description: Choice on window close (background or quit) and per-session / per-workspace child windows for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
manifest.author: lczment

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

给 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** 加两件事：关闭窗口时由你决定「最小化到后台」还是「完全退出」，以及把某个会话 / 整个工作区丢进独立子窗口。

> 这是第三方扩展，不是 DeepSeek 官方组件。它会修改本机 DeepSeek Harness 的 `resources/app`（见「安装」），升级 DSH 后需要重跑一次安装脚本。

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **关闭行为可选** | 关闭主窗口时弹出与主界面同风格的对话框：最小化到后台 / 完全退出 / 取消，可勾选「记住我的选择」。 |
| **设置页** | 设置 → 「窗口与多开」：三个选项（每次询问 / 最小化到后台 / 完全退出），立即生效，和关闭对话框共用同一份配置。 |
| **侧栏快捷入口** | 侧栏底部、设置齿轮上方新增「多开」按钮（窄栏时只显示图标），点开即可改关闭行为或把目标丢进子窗口。 |
| **每会话独立窗口** | 会话行悬停时在「…」菜单旁出现一个窗口图标，点击即把该会话开进新窗口。 |
| **工作区整窗** | 设置页里每个工作区都有 **Open workspace**，把整个工作区开进新窗口。 |
| **后台保活** | 选「最小化到后台」后进程与 Agent 继续运行，托盘图标可重新打开或退出。 |
| **悬停动效** | 插件内按钮带 120ms 过渡；系统开启「减少动画」时自动关闭位移效果。 |
| **无黑框** | 安装 / 升级收尾通过隐藏的 `wscript` 启动，不会闪控制台窗口。 |

DSH 插件运行在 Host（Node 子进程）与 Web 前端里，**没有**窗口或退出的 IPC。因此本项目由两部分组成：

1. **插件**（`index.js` / `client.js`，仓库根目录）— 设置页、侧栏按钮、会话行按钮、关闭对话框的 UI 与 Host 路由。
2. **壳扩展**（`shell/install.mjs`）— 注入 Electron 主进程，接管窗口关闭、创建子窗口、读写共享配置。安装脚本在 `tools/`。

只装插件：设置页与多开按钮会出现，但顶部会提示壳扩展未安装，关闭窗口仍走 DSH 原行为。
前置：Windows、DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` 或更新、Node.js 可用（安装脚本用）。

已发布到 npm：`@lczment/dsh-window@0.1.0`。任选一种：

- 市场 / 命令行安装：`dsh plugin add @lczment/dsh-window`，或在 **设置 → 插件 → 发现** 里搜索 DSH Window；
- 官方列表条目已提交 [awesome-dsh-plugin#12113](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/12113)，索引构建后进入默认货架；
- 也可以直接从仓库安装：`dsh plugin add github:lczment/dsh-window`；
- 本地开发时把目录链接到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@lczment\dsh-window`。

安装后打开 **设置 → 窗口与多开**，应能看到本页。

> 需要写入 `D:\DeepSeek Harness`（或你的安装目录），并以当前用户运行 PowerShell。

```powershell
node tools/install-shell-extension.mjs --stage-only

readme.section: 注册隐藏的收尾任务（每分钟检查一次，成功后自动删除）
readme.text: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/register-completion-task.ps1

readme.section: 然后：托盘图标 → 退出。约一分钟内应用会带着扩展重启
readme.text:
```

> 通过市场 / npm 安装时，插件位于 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@lczment\dsh-window`（设置了 `DSH_HOME` 则在 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@lczment\dsh-window`），把上面命令里的 `tools/` 换成该目录下的 `tools/` 即可。

readme.section: 然后：托盘图标 → 退出。约一分钟内应用会带着扩展重启
readme.text:
`--stage-only` 会：解包 `resources/app.asar` → `resources/app`、叠加 `app.asar.unpacked`、给 `lib/main.js` 打补丁（关闭钩子、子窗口 WebSocket 白名单、子窗口 IPC 放行）、给 `lib/preload-app.cjs` 加 `window.dshWindow` 桥，然后等应用退出时把 `app.asar` 改名为 `app.asar.orig`。powershell
$env:DSH_DESKTOP_ROOT = 'E:\Apps\DeepSeek Harness'
```

收尾任务有 75 秒健康检查：启动后扩展没写日志、或补丁缺失，会自动回滚到原版 `app.asar` 并重启，不会把应用留在坏状态。

- 设置页顶部显示绿色 “Desktop shell extension is installed”。
- 关闭主窗口 → 出现与主界面同风格的对话框。
- 侧栏会话悬停 → 出现窗口图标；点击后新窗口加载该会话。

配置文件：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\desktop\window-policy.json`（`DSH_HOME` 存在时用 `$DSH_HOME\desktop\window-policy.json`）。

```json
{ "closeAction": "ask" }
```

- `ask` — 每次关闭都询问（默认）
- `background` — 直接隐藏到托盘
- `quit` — 直接退出

关闭对话框勾选「记住我的选择」会写入同一文件；设置页修改后立即广播给所有窗口。

DSH 升级会带回新的 `resources/app.asar`，旧补丁随之失效（`resources/app` 会被忽略或覆盖）。重新执行第 2 步即可：

```powershell
node tools/install-shell-extension.mjs --stage-only
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/register-completion-task.ps1
```

插件部分通常不需要重装。
```powershell

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/uninstall-shell-extension.ps1
```

再在 **设置 → 插件** 里移除本插件。卸载脚本会恢复 `app.asar.orig`、删除 `resources/app` 与 `resources/dsh-window-extension`。

- 已发布到 npm：[`@lczment/dsh-window`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lczment/dsh-window)（0.1.0）。官方货架下一次构建索引时会收录。
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lczment/dsh-window/main/index.json
  ```

该索引使用 npm 源，安装走 `@lczment/dsh-window`。
- 也可以直接按仓库安装：`dsh plugin add github:lczment/dsh-window`，或下载 [Release v0.1.0](https://github.com/lczment/dsh-window/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 的 `dsh-window.tgz`。
- 官方列表条目已提交：[awesome-dsh-plugin#12113](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/12113)（`market/lczment__dsh-window.yml`）。

- 仅 Windows：壳扩展依赖 DSH 的 win32 托盘、`titleBarOverlay` 与 PowerShell 安装脚本。
- 壳扩展是**对本机安装目录的补丁**，不是官方扩展点；DSH 升级后要重跑。
- 子窗口与主窗口共享同一份登录 cookie 与 Host 连接；会话数据是同一个 runtime。
- 应用正在运行时 `app.asar` 被占用，所以切换必须等退出后由收尾任务完成。
- 关闭对话框依赖前端已加载；前端尚未就绪时回退到系统原生对话框。

```
dsh-window/
  index.js             Host 半：/dsh-window/policy、/targets、/boot-injections 路由
  client.js            Client 半：设置分区、侧栏按钮、会话行按钮、关闭对话框
  locale/{en,zh}.json  显示名与描述

```powershell
node tools/smoke-client.mjs      # 用桩环境渲染 client.js，校验 4 个插槽与关闭对话框
node --check client.js index.js shell/install.mjs
```
MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

English | [简体中文](README.md)

A small add-on for **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**: choose what closing the window does, and open a session or a whole workspace in its own child window.

> This is a third-party add-on, not an official DeepSeek component. It patches the local DeepSeek Harness `resources/app` (see *Install*) and must be re-applied after a DSH update.

| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Close behaviour** | Closing the main window opens a dialog in the app's own style: minimise to background, quit, or cancel, with *remember my choice*. |
| **Settings section** | Settings → "Windows & multi-window": ask / minimise to background / quit, applied immediately and sharing the same stored policy as the dialog. |
| **Sidebar shortcut** | A "Multi-window" button at the sidebar footer, above the settings gear (icon only in the narrow rail); opens the same options and target list. |
| **Per-session window** | Hovering a session row shows a window icon next to the "…" menu; clicking opens that session in a new window. |
| **Whole workspace** | Every workspace in the settings page has **Open workspace**, opening the workspace in a new window. |
| **Keep running** | With "minimise to background" the process and agents keep running; the tray icon can reopen or quit. |
| **Hover motion** | 120ms transitions on plugin buttons, disabled when the system prefers reduced motion. |
| **No console flash** | The finish step runs through a hidden `wscript` launcher, so the installer never shows a terminal window. |

DSH plugins run in the Host (a Node child process) and the web frontend, and they have **no** IPC for windows or quitting. The project therefore has two parts:

1. **Plugin** (`index.js` / `client.js`, repository root) — settings section, sidebar buttons, per-session button, the close dialog UI, and Host routes.
2. **Shell extension** (`shell/install.mjs`) — injected into the Electron main process; owns window closing, child windows, and the shared policy file. Install scripts live in `tools/`.
With only the plugin installed, the settings page and buttons appear but the page warns that the shell extension is missing, and closing keeps DSH's original behaviour.
Requires Windows, DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` or newer, and Node.js (for the installer).
Then open **Settings → Windows & multi-window**; the page should be there.

> Needs write access to `D:\DeepSeek Harness` (or your install directory) and PowerShell as the current user.

```powershell
node tools/install-shell-extension.mjs --stage-only

readme.section: register the hidden finish task (checks once a minute, deletes itself on success)
readme.text: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/register-completion-task.ps1

readme.section: then: tray icon → Quit. The app comes back with the extension within a minute
readme.text:
```

> When installed from the market / npm, the package lives at `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@lczment\dsh-window` (or `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@lczment\dsh-window`); run the same commands from that directory instead of the repository root.

readme.section: then: tray icon → Quit. The app comes back with the extension within a minute
readme.text:
`--stage-only` unpacks `resources/app.asar` into `resources/app`, overlays `app.asar.unpacked`, patches `lib/main.js` (close hook, child-window WebSocket allowlist, child-window IPC), adds the `window.dshWindow` bridge to `lib/preload-app.cjs`, and waits for the app to exit before renaming `app.asar` to `app.asar.orig`.powershell
$env:DSH_DESKTOP_ROOT = 'E:\Apps\DeepSeek Harness'
```

readme.section: then: tray icon → Quit. The app comes back with the extension within a minute
readme.text: The finish task has a 75-second health check: if the extension never logs a successful install, or a patch is missing, it restores the original `app.asar` and restarts the app, so the install cannot leave a broken state.

- The settings page shows a green "Desktop shell extension is installed".
- Closing the main window shows the in-app dialog.
- Hovering a sidebar session shows the window icon; clicking loads that session in a new window.

Policy file: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\desktop\window-policy.json` (or `$DSH_HOME\desktop\window-policy.json` when `DSH_HOME` is set).

```json
{ "closeAction": "ask" }
```

- `ask` — ask on every close (default)
- `background` — hide to the tray
- `quit` — quit

"Remember my choice" in the dialog writes the same file; changes in the settings page are broadcast to every window immediately.

A DSH update brings back a fresh `resources/app.asar` and the patch stops applying (`resources/app` is ignored or overwritten). Re-run step 2:

```powershell
node tools/install-shell-extension.mjs --stage-only
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/register-completion-task.ps1
```

The plugin itself usually does not need reinstalling.
```powershell

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/uninstall-shell-extension.ps1
```

Then remove the plugin in **Settings → Plugins**. The uninstall script restores `app.asar.orig` and removes `resources/app` and `resources/dsh-window-extension`.

- Published on npm: [`@lczment/dsh-window`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lczment/dsh-window) (0.1.0). The official catalog picks it up on its next index build.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lczment/dsh-window/main/index.json
  ```

That index uses the npm source and installs `@lczment/dsh-window`.
- You can also install straight from the repository: `dsh plugin add github:lczment/dsh-window`, or download `dsh-window.tgz` from [Release v0.1.0](https://github.com/lczment/dsh-window/releases/tag/v0.1.0).
- The catalog entry is submitted: [awesome-dsh-plugin#12113](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/12113) (`market/lczment__dsh-window.yml`).

- Windows only: the shell extension relies on DSH's win32 tray, `titleBarOverlay`, and the PowerShell installer.
- The shell extension is a **patch of the local installation**, not an official extension point; re-run it after a DSH update.
- Child windows share the same session cookie and Host connection as the main window; all windows talk to the same runtime.
- `app.asar` is locked while the app runs, so the switch always happens after exit, via the finish task.
- The close dialog needs the frontend to be loaded; before that it falls back to the native message box.

```
dsh-window/
  index.js            Host half: /dsh-window/policy, /targets, /boot-injections routes
  client.js           Client half: settings section, sidebar buttons, per-session button, close dialog
  locale/{en,zh}.json Display name and description

```powershell
node tools/smoke-client.mjs      # renders client.js in a stub environment; checks 4 slots and the close dialog
node --check client.js index.js shell/install.mjs
```
MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
